releases.label: Expandable upgrade summaries
notes: Expand the new-version banner to review every available release before updating.
Show release history in stable build order, with accessible controls and a safe fallback when notes are unavailable.

releases.label: Consistent Recent Channels cards
notes: Keep Recent Channels cards at a consistent height and truncate message previews to one line, including long text and mentions.

releases.label: Faster scope switching
notes: Keep Deck scope changes responsive by reusing live local WApp and Recent Work data instead of refetching unchanged workspace projections.
Coalesce overlapping WApp update refreshes and avoid rewriting unchanged local WApp records during live activity.

releases.label: Reliable application updates
notes: Show immediate progress and prevent duplicate actions while an application update is being prepared.
Wait for a complete release and its service worker before reloading, with a bounded one-time recovery for stale assets.

releases.label: Automatic update completion
notes: Reload automatically when the verified new worker activates, including browsers that keep the same page controller.
Stop stalled update attempts within the configured limit and show an actionable retry state instead of remaining on Updating indefinitely.

releases.label: Local Inbox search and progressive loading
notes: Search the complete locally available Inbox as you type, including titles, card text, and older messages within chat threads.
Open the Inbox with the newest 50 matching cards and progressively reveal 50 more near the end of the list or with the accessible load-more control.

releases.label: Submit-only Inbox search
notes: Apply Inbox searches only after submitting the search field, so typing a draft does not change the visible cards.
Clear both draft and active Inbox searches when switching scope, restoring the newest 50 cards for that scope.

releases.label: Cleaner Inbox search field
notes: Remove the redundant visible Search Inbox label while keeping the search field accessible to assistive technology.

releases.label: Immediate Inbox search clearing
notes: Restore the full newest-first Inbox immediately when the search field is cleared, including with the native clear control.
Clear Inbox search and return to the first 50 cards whenever the selected scope or channel changes.

releases.label: Compact WApp Recents cards
notes: Open launchable WApp activity from one clear View action, preferring approved deep links and safely falling back to matching My WApps launchers.
Scan shorter WApp Recents cards with routine metadata hidden and read, dismiss, and mute controls moved into an accessible actions menu.

releases.label: Reliable application update activation
notes: Complete application updates reliably when multiple open Flight Deck tabs participate in service-worker activation.

releases.label: Stable live WApp Recents
notes: Render cached WApp Recents immediately from workspace-local data and update cards, unread counts, and mutes automatically as sync materializes changes.
Keep background reconciliation silent and avoid repeated WApp feed reads while live Tower updates are connected.

releases.label: Quieter profile relay defaults
notes: Stop connecting to relay.nostr.band for profile metadata while retaining the remaining profile relay fallbacks.

releases.label: Compact Inbox header
notes: Keep the Inbox title, search field, magnifier submit, and actions menu together on one responsive row, with New thread available from the actions menu.

releases.label: Efficient channel refresh
notes: Stop channel-directory refreshes from repeatedly downloading every channel's complete thread and message history.

releases.label: Faster local-first navigation
notes: Open cached channels immediately, refresh only the newest remote message page, and reuse recent channel refreshes.
Bound WApp Recents reconciliation so repeated live updates cannot continuously download the complete activity archive.
Reuse rendered Markdown and load the rich-text editor only when an editing surface opens.

releases.label: Working View actions for WApp Recents
notes: Show the View action on active WApp Recent cards when their own deep link is unavailable but a matching safe My WApps launcher is registered.

releases.label: Bounded live workspace refresh
notes: Process live Tower updates through their targeted local collection instead of repeatedly requesting the whole workspace delta.
Stop startup from crawling tasks, documents, files, and audio across every channel when those records are already materialized locally.
Load storage-backed document bodies only when a document is opened instead of downloading every document during list refresh.

releases.label: Compact reconnect catch-up
notes: Collapse large live-event replay bursts into one cursor-based workspace update instead of probing every historical task, thread, reaction, and document target.
Discard replay events already covered by a reconnect update so catch-up work is not immediately repeated.

releases.label: Reliable WApp Recent View actions
notes: Refresh the current user's My WApps launchers together with WApp Recents so View actions appear after a cold reload or stale local cache.

releases.label: WApp Recents on new devices
notes: Load WApp Recents and their matching My WApps launchers during first-time workspace setup, including browsers with an empty local cache.

releases.label: Bounded reaction refresh
notes: Fetch reactions only for chat messages and comments currently visible on screen, with duplicate refreshes reused for 30 seconds.
Stop requesting reactions for every workspace task and stop sweeping every channel when the task board opens.
Limit reconnect replay deltas so consecutive historical event batches do not repeatedly refresh the whole workspace.

releases.label: Stable current sync cursor
notes: Stop repeated SSE fallback syncs from requesting a workspace cursor that Tower has already confirmed is current.

releases.label: Clearer Inbox controls
notes: Keep New thread visible in the Inbox header, use a more compact search control, and label the search field Search Inbox.

releases.label: Tighter Inbox header
notes: Group the Inbox header controls consistently and simplify New thread to a compact plus button.

releases.label: Task mentions for agents
notes: Mention agents directly in task descriptions and task comments with the same selectable mention pills used in chat.
Send newly saved task assignments through Tower's typed assignment contract without retriggering unchanged assignments.

releases.label: Reliable task agent handoffs
notes: Mention agents directly in task descriptions and task comments with selectable mention pills that survive refresh.
Send newly saved task assignments through Tower's typed assignment contract without retriggering unchanged assignments.
Open task mentions and same-site task links reliably from chat, including tasks that need to be loaded before detail opens.

releases.label: Continuous task comments
notes: Keep a newly submitted task comment visible while Tower's task activity snapshot catches up, without showing a duplicate when the server copy arrives.

releases.label: Personal Deck and document agent controls
notes: Choose whether My Focus appears on the Deck from Setup; it now defaults to hidden and can be restored without changing Daily Scope data.
Mention agents in document comments and replies with the same selectable mention pills used elsewhere in Flight Deck.
Send document reviews to the default agent and inspect associated Autopilot sessions from the document actions menu.

releases.label: Reliable document agent routing
notes: Route full-document reviews with Tower's deterministic document trigger and open the exact document-bound sessions returned by Autopilot.

releases.label: Reliable live document comments
notes: See new document comments and inline replies automatically, without refresh or navigation replacing a newer discussion with an empty or stale view.

releases.label: Complete inline document conversations
notes: See replies to replies in document comment threads, including agent responses nested beneath a follow-up.

releases.label: Clearer document comment conversations
notes: Read every reply in a document comment conversation at one consistent indentation, including replies to replies.

releases.label: Denser text in Wingman on iPhone
notes: Fit more Flight Deck text on screen inside the Wingman iPhone app while keeping the standalone PWA layout and sizing unchanged.

releases.label: Unread channels first in All
notes: See unread channels first in the workspace All view with bold, high-emphasis labels, while scoped channel ordering stays unchanged.

releases.label: Feed dismiss controls
notes: Use the renamed Feed panel to dismiss one linkout card without opening it, or dismiss every item matching the current Feed filters from the options menu.
Keep dismissed Feed items cleared across refreshes through the existing server-backed item state.

releases.label: iPhone channel tab swiping
notes: Swipe the overflowing channel tab bar horizontally inside Wingman on iPhone while taps, tab menus, and header controls keep working normally.

releases.label: Responsive Feed dismissal
notes: See Feed cards disappear immediately when dismissing one or all matching items, with automatic restoration and clear feedback if the server cannot save the dismissal.

releases.label: Live Feed outstanding count
notes: See the Feed outstanding count update immediately when dismissing one or all items, including restoring the count if the server cannot save a dismissal.

releases.label: Persistent Feed dismissals
notes: Keep dismissed Feed cards and their outstanding count cleared after a full page refresh.

releases.label: Inbox-first mobile Deck
notes: Open the mobile Deck directly on Inbox, with Hello and Links one swipe to the right and Feed and Recent to the left.
Use four accessible Deck indicators while preserving the selected card through orientation changes and return navigation.

releases.label: Reliable mobile Inbox entry
notes: Enter the mobile Deck on Inbox every time from the workspace avatar's All view or a scope's Home view, without briefly showing Hello and Links first.

releases.label: Reliable return to channel Decks
notes: Return from a thread to the complete channel Deck without refreshing, with Hello and Links, Agents, and WApps still available.

releases.label: Reliable task return to channel Decks
notes: Return from a task through its channel link to the complete channel Deck, with Hello and Links, Agents, and WApps still reachable on desktop and mobile.

releases.label: Sticky mobile Deck headers
notes: Keep Inbox, Feed, and Recent titles and controls visible while scrolling their mobile Deck cards.

releases.label: Sequential chat catch-up
notes: Move through the chats visible in the current Deck list with Left and Right Arrow or deliberate horizontal swipes, without returning to the list between threads.
Use compact newer and older controls in the thread header, with navigation stopping at the visible list boundaries.

releases.label: Single-panel chat catch-up
notes: Navigate through any number of visible Deck chats in one thread panel, then close once to return directly to the original Deck list context.

releases.label: Reliable new direct messages
notes: Open direct-message creation from the DMs New control whether DMs Home or an existing direct message is selected.

releases.label: Reliable document uploads
notes: Upload valid DOCX files without a local database error, including when the browser omits their content type.
Choose a scope and channel before the upload dialog opens when Files has no channel context, with clear stage-specific failure details.

releases.label: Persistent personal agent lists
notes: Keep My Agents saved in Tower across refreshes and browser clients, while stale clients reload the newer list instead of clearing it.

releases.label: Reliable image paste routing
notes: Paste images and files into a Deck-opened message using that message's channel, even when the Deck itself has a different channel selected.
Keep the reply composer safely unavailable with a clear loading message until its channel context is ready.

releases.label: Durable agent activity
notes: Keep the newest agent turn visible when older completed activity is replayed, including after reconnecting.
Preserve current-work context with clear stale, reconnecting, and update-error states plus a removal control.

releases.label: Clearer pasted screenshots and reliable Deck return
notes: Insert numbered screenshot placeholders at the chat cursor when images are pasted, while retaining attachment thumbnails and upload handling.
Restore the complete responsive channel Deck after returning from a thread whose route hydration replaced the Deck markup.

releases.label: Inline pasted chat images
notes: Paste an image at any point in a chat message and keep it inline at that exact position after upload, while its attachment thumbnail remains available below the composer.

releases.label: Faster live agent replies
notes: Keep healthy live updates connected after background refreshes so completed agent replies appear promptly instead of waiting for the 15-second fallback poll.
Automatically retry live updates after a prolonged connection outage while preserving offline polling.

releases.label: Visible Agent Direct progress
notes: Show Agent Direct receipt and commentary updates in a thread opened from Deck, restore them after reconnecting, and clear the working state when the final reply completes.

releases.label: Agent thinking history
notes: Keep the latest Agent Direct thinking update concise and live, with an accessible second expansion for the full ordered thinking history that survives reconnects.

releases.label: Retry failed chat messages
notes: Resend your failed outgoing chat messages from their message menu while preserving the original text, mentions, and attachments.

releases.label: Reliable attachment resends
notes: Resend failed messages with fresh copies of their attachments, avoiding attachment ownership conflicts while preserving filenames, file types, and message links.

releases.label: Safe document saves
notes: Keep document edits open while pasted images upload, and return to Read mode only after the document save is confirmed.

releases.label: Preserve newly pasted document drafts
notes: Keep text and rich-content drafts intact when a newly opened document's background refresh finishes after editing has begun.

releases.label: Save the visible document editor
notes: Prevent duplicate rich-editor mounts from making Save read an empty editor while another visible editor contains your document.
Keep the visible draft open with an explicit error if editor serialization ever disagrees with the content shown on screen.

releases.label: Delegated WApp management
notes: Grant a person or agent narrow, expiring WApp management authority from Setup → Permissions, preview its limits before signing, and revoke it immediately.
Assign existing WApps through installation intents and inspect pending, active, failed, repairable, or revoked lifecycle state with reconcile and revoke controls.

releases.label: Stable comment reply drafts
notes: Keep long task and document comment drafts positioned at the current line while typing, and preserve a manually enlarged reply box instead of collapsing it on the next character.

releases.label: Reliable Feed links
notes: Open approved Feed View links at their complete destination, preserving query details and page fragments instead of falling back to the WApp root.

releases.label: Tower-approved Feed destinations
notes: Open a Tower-approved Feed destination immediately, including its query and page fragment, even while the local WApp permission list is still loading.

releases.label: Quieter sidebar navigation
notes: Remove redundant unread dots from top-level sidebar destinations while keeping unread indicators on individual channels.

releases.label: Live-only agent activity
notes: Keep current agent working and thinking activity visible in blue while hiding stale, connecting, and failed activity cards.

releases.label: Faster Agent Direct threads
notes: Open cached Deck threads immediately from local data without waiting for a Tower refresh.
Apply normal Agent Direct activity updates incrementally instead of refetching the channel's full activity history for every update.

releases.label: Visible background catch-up
notes: Keep cached workspace content usable while Flight Deck receives and applies startup changes, with a compact progress message for updates lasting longer than 1.5 seconds.
Show a clear retry state if startup updating stalls instead of leaving the workspace looking frozen.

releases.label: Operator-neutral setup guidance
notes: Use neutral example hosts, project paths, and browser-identity guidance throughout setup and managed WApp activation screens.

releases.label: Resumable workspace startup
notes: Load large workspaces in bounded pages, keep each completed page after an interruption, and resume without clearing browser storage.
Stop stalled startup requests within 30 seconds and show a retryable Update stalled state.

releases.label: Stable paginated startup completion
notes: Complete the final workspace snapshot transaction without repeatedly reopening the Update stalled message.

releases.label: Faster channel switching
notes: Switch cached channels without briefly clearing the conversation or showing messages beneath the wrong channel heading.
Ignore late channel loads during rapid navigation and enrich the destination conversation after its first visible frame.

releases.label: Instant cached chat navigation
notes: Show cached channels and scope feeds immediately while local and Tower reconciliation continues after the first frame.
Keep recent chat presentation state bounded while preserving threads, pending messages, expansion state, and scroll restoration.

releases.label: Paint-first chat navigation
notes: Paint cached or pending channel and scope state before board, route, subscription, scroll, unread, and reconciliation work begins.
Copy recent click-to-state and click-to-paint timings from the unobtrusive chat timing control for desktop or mobile validation.

releases.label: Shared work context controller
notes: Route the shared scope and channel bar through one controller across Deck, Chat, Tasks, and Docs.

releases.label: Deck-first work context navigation
notes: Open Deck whenever the shared scope or channel bar selects a new work context, including selections made from Chat, Tasks, or Docs.
Paint the destination Deck context before cleaning up the previous section or refreshing recent changes, routes, subscriptions, and background sync.

releases.label: Reliable chat file attachments
notes: Attach Markdown and other non-image files directly to chat messages and new threads without a local database error.

releases.label: Expanded workspace navigation
notes: Browse every visible scope and channel in the expanded desktop sidebar while the primary navigation and workspace selector stay fixed.
Scroll long scope and channel lists inside the sidebar, then open any channel directly in its full Chat context.

releases.label: Deck-aware sidebar channels
notes: Open Deck when selecting a channel from the expanded sidebar, matching the shared workspace channel bar.
Show resolved participant names for direct-message channels in the expanded sidebar.

releases.label: Clear mobile Inbox header
notes: Keep Inbox cards hidden beneath the fixed Inbox and search header while scrolling on mobile.

releases.label: Scope Home sidebar links
notes: Open a scope's Home view in Deck by selecting its heading in the expanded sidebar, with clear keyboard focus and current-page feedback.

releases.label: Workspace overview sidebar link
notes: Open the whole-workspace Deck from a workspace avatar link above the expanded sidebar hierarchy, clearly separated from Setup.

releases.label: Sidebar channel unread state
notes: See unread workspace channels at a glance in the expanded sidebar with the same red dot and bold label used by the channel toolbar.
Open the whole-workspace Deck from the expanded sidebar's clearer View All control.

releases.label: Reliable Feed-only WApp activation
notes: Activate an existing WApp with Feed-only authority without requiring a channel destination.

releases.label: Responsive sidebar navigation
notes: Use the complete Home, scope, and channel hierarchy in the opened mobile drawer, with scoped channel creation and channel settings controls.
Keep one workspace navigation surface on desktop: the sidebar when expanded and the horizontal channel bar when collapsed.

releases.label: Permission-safe sidebar creation
notes: Show each scope's channel creation shortcut only when the current workspace permissions make creation available there.

releases.label: Clear mobile sidebar selectors
notes: Show labelled Deck, Chat, Tasks, Docs, and Files controls above the open mobile sidebar while keeping the existing scope, channel, and compact controls when it is closed.

releases.label: Correct expanded sidebar selectors
notes: Move the labelled Deck, Chat, Tasks, Docs, and Files picker into the horizontal top bar when the left column is open, leaving the column for workspace scopes and channels.

releases.label: Restore mobile Setup selector
notes: Reach Setup from the labelled horizontal section picker while the mobile left column is open.

releases.label: Show Setup in expanded picker
notes: Reach Setup from the labelled horizontal section picker whenever the left column is open, including laptop and desktop layouts.

releases.label: Reliable live-update authentication
notes: Keep live workspace updates connected when Tower verifies the complete stream URL, including the latest reconnect cursor.

releases.label: Cleaner Home navigation
notes: Show Home directly beneath the section navigation without an extra horizontal divider in expanded desktop and mobile sidebars.

releases.label: Instant document editing
notes: Open documents in TipTap immediately, preserve typing while edit access is acquired, and provide safe retry, copy, and discard recovery when access or versions conflict.

releases.label: Durable Agent Direct thinking
notes: Keep Agent Direct thinking and commentary visible through live-update disconnects, reconnect replay, and missed terminal events.

releases.label: Reliable document autosave
notes: Keep TipTap saves on the latest accepted document version so autosave cannot mistake its own successful update for an external conflict.

releases.label: Efficient live updates
notes: Keep healthy live-update connections on the normal heartbeat cadence instead of repeatedly reloading the workspace after each update.

releases.label: Correct document self-conflicts
notes: Accept each successful TipTap save as the new local edit base before live updates arrive, preventing a document from conflicting with its own autosave.

releases.label: Fast live-update reloads
notes: Resume live workspace updates from the browser's materialised Tower cursor on first reload instead of replaying the workspace history from the beginning.

releases.label: Inbox review and document editing fixes
notes: Mark unread review tasks done directly from Inbox, moving them to Done and clearing their unread state while leaving other Inbox read actions unchanged.
Keep rich Markdown list items stable across repeated document open and autosave cycles without accumulating visible escape characters.
